title: Traditional Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A classic North African dish made with tender lamb, fragrant spices, and dried fruits, slow-cooked in a clay pot.

ingredients.name: Algerian spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

ingredients.name: Garlicky olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and Algerian spice mix. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the dried apricots, prunes, flour, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the sliced almonds and continue to bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
